narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The trick worked for four numbers. With five numbers, some answers will be odd.
<bookmark mark='many'/>There are many more ways to place the signs than three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Trying a few cannot cover them all, so we need a reason that covers every way.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Switching a sign changes the total by an even amount, so the parity stays.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Put signs between one, two, three, four and five in two ways. Are the answers odd or even?
